history.content: hey there. how's it going today?
Hey there — I’m here with you, steady and curious. What’s been going on for you today?
honestly not the best. it's been kind of a weird week. nothing dramatic, just... off i guess
That sounds a little off and hard to pin down. Does it feel more blank, foggy, or just not quite like yourself?

no it's not foggy actually. i think i know exactly what it is, i've just been avoiding saying it. my friend dani had this birthday dinner saturday and i found out afterwards i wasn't invited. like a whole group of us, people i thought i was close with, and i just wasn't on the list
That sounds hurtful — especially with people you thought you were close with. Does it feel more like hurt, left out, or a bit embarrassed too?

all of it really. but mostly just... let down? like i saw the photos on instagram before anyone even said anything to me. and dani and i have known each other since uni. i would've invited her without thinking twice. it makes me question whether i read the whole friendship wrong
That sounds like let down and hurt, with a sting of being unseen too. What does it make you want to do — pull back, ask about it, or go quiet?

my instinct is to just pull back and say nothing. pretend i didn't see. but that feels like the cowardly version. part of me wants to ask dani directly but i'm scared the answer is just that i matter less to them than i thought

That sounds like a painful mix of wanting to pull back and wanting the truth. I’m wondering if the sharpest part is not knowing whether it was about the invite, or about what it seemed to say about how much you matter to them?

yeah. that's exactly it. it's not the dinner, i don't even love big dinners. it's what it seems to say. but saying it out loud like this makes it feel a bit smaller somehow. maybe one missed invite isn't the whole story of a 7 year friendship
That makes sense — the dinner itself is smaller than the meaning it took on. We can leave it there, or stay with what this might be asking for underneath; either way is fine.
i think i'll leave it there for now. but thank you, really. this helped more than i expected. i might actually text dani tomorrow. ok, gonna go. take care x
Of course — I’m glad it helped. Take care, and you can come back to it anytime.
